entries.title: Fixed Nested Case and Twin Cord Channel Inro
entries.description: One newly authored complete static plain inro-inspired nested case with its cord and pierced slider. Three whole flattened rounded-oblong compartments each have a real inner cavity, finite bottom and upper nesting lip; the upper two and the whole top lid have matching underside receiver recesses. Two columns of full through-bored side channel bosses remain seated to the four case sections. One continuous finite tube cord rises from a hidden fixed root through the left column, converges through a real bored slider, makes an open upper return loop and descends through the right column to its other fixed root. The slider and roots use explicit small hidden fixed contacts, not a working sliding or detachable mechanism. The entire shape, superellipse section, nesting cross-sections, side-channel sequence and cord route are original numeric geometry. Unlike a rectangular observation case with exterior stack feet, bearing rails, handle and latches, this is an internally nested flattened case with axial side cords; unlike a gift parcel it has genuine cavities, aligned passages and one returning cord rather than sealed box faces and two perpendicular ribbon wraps. Fourteen whole closed editable meshes, four opaque constant PBR roles, metres, native Z up, horizontal whole bounds-centred ground origin with a finite base sole. One new complete model and zero scenes; compartments, cord and slider are not counted as separate assets.
